subject: Capacity top‑up playbook and pro‑rate schedule
messages:
From: Maya Turner <maya.turner@quickcart.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@quickcart.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Need quick top‑up plan and billing timing

Hi Laura,

Quick note from our ops team: we see a sustained 30% QoQ traffic increase and we need to lock in extra hosted capacity for June/July — likely a 40% monthly commit uplift. We need clarity on:
- A short summary of available top‑up tiers and per‑token rates for the next 3 months
- How pro‑rata billing will work if we add mid‑month
- Any rate limits or soft‑throttle behaviours we should expect during the ramp

We're under a tight procurement lead time (PO in by 31 May) so a short playbook or checklist would be super helpful.

Thanks,
Maya Turner
Head of Platform, QuickCart Inc.
maya.turner@quickcart.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Maya Turner <maya.turner@quickcart.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need quick top‑up plan and billing timing

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up.

We can do a 40% commit top‑up for June and a staged uplift for July. Quick answers up front:
- Top‑up tiers: Standard (+20%), Plus (+40%), and Sprint (+60%) with step discounts. See attached spreadsheet for line‑items and token rates.
- Pro‑rata billing: we invoice only for the days the higher commit is in effect; Sales Ops will generate a pro‑rata invoice once you confirm the effective date.
- Rate limits/soft throttle: we maintain per‑route latency SLOs; soft throttles kick in when an account exceeds burst allowances. We'll include a recommended guardrail (token rate cap per route) to avoid degraded latency.

Proposed next steps (short timeline):
1) You confirm target uplift and effective date by 31 May.
2) We lock pricing and generate PO + pro‑rata invoice.
3) Ops (Karthik) applies route caps and enables burst pocket for first 14 days.
4) 2‑week monitoring window, then we finalize commit for July.

I'll loop Karthik and Aditya to scope the ops plan; Vanessa will coordinate billing. Can we jump on a 20‑minute call this afternoon?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
(415) 555‑0123

Attachments: QuickCart_topup_pricing_20270525.xlsx (pricing grid)

Looping in ops + billing details. High level: we can enact a +40% commit across hosted API for an agreed effective date with the following constraints:
- Karthik: we need the list of routes (api keys + primary routes) that QuickCart expects to ramp so we can pre‑apply per‑route throttles and a burst pocket.
- Vanessa: sales ops will create a pro‑rata invoice; if effective date is mid‑billing cycle we should prorate to the day and include a credit line for the remainder of the month if they bump to an annual commit.

Karthik — can you confirm SLA and soft‑throttle behaviour for +40% on a short ramp (14d)? Also estimate any expected need for capacity reservation on our Dedicated pools (likely not for hosted).

Aditya

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Need quick top‑up plan and billing timing

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 10:30 AM aditya_rao@redwood.com wrote:
> Karthik — can you confirm SLA and soft‑throttle behaviour for +40% on a short ramp (14d)?

We ran a simulation against our hosted runtime for a 40% steady uplift with QuickCart‑like route distribution last month. Summary:
- Expected latency SLO impact: <5% p50 increase for 99% of requests when burst pocket is enabled.
- Failure modes: if they burst >3x their baseline per route we will engage route‑level soft throttle (token shedding).
- Ops checklist I will execute: pre‑apply route caps (per api key), enable 14‑day burst pocket (10% of uplift tokens reserved), and create a regression alert tied to QuickCart's prompt set.

Notes for sales ops: plan for a single mid‑month activation (we can flip the commit on a chosen date). No Dedicated reservation required.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

(attachment referenced: pro-rate-schedule-draft.pdf)

- Apply the per‑route caps and enable the 14‑day burst pocket on 2027‑06‑15 (Samir will share the route list by EOD 28 May).
- Share a short runbook for our oncall in case they hit soft throttle.

We will issue PO by 31 May as requested. Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the coordination.
